description: DocAIQ parsing/extraction eval set. Each case scores any subset of {fields, reference_text, table_cells, retrieval}. Offline cases pair an expected + predicted JSON. To grow the set: drop a labeled doc's expected.json here and (for now) a hand/checked predicted.json; live mode (running the real pipeline to produce predicted) is a G2 follow-up. Add scanned/JPG, table-heavy, and multi-language cases to exercise OCR (G3/G6/G11), tables (G8), and chunking (G5).
